::: {#def-renyi-entropy}
#### Rényi entropy of order 2 (collision entropy)

The **Rényi entropy of order 2**, also called the **collision entropy**, of a random variable $X$ is the negative [logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm) of the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of its probability
[@wikipedia_renyi_entropy]: <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

$$H_2(X) = -\log \E{\P(X)}.$$

:::
